summary: Completed comprehensive testing of new Taxxa presentation demo page with Tanzania/Kenya country support, citizen app demo, admin dashboard, side-by-side view, and prize configuration functionality

ui_bugs.issue: Country switching doesn't update merchants and currency in demo modes - Tanzania merchants (TZS) still show when Kenya is selected
ui_bugs.details: Header shows Kenya selected and 'Kenya Revenue Authority (KRA)' but demo modes still display Tanzania merchants (Shoppers Plaza, Game Stores, Mlimani) and TZS currency instead of Kenya merchants (Carrefour Nairobi, Naivas, Quickmart) and KES currency

Header displays 'Taxxa Presentation Mode' correctly
Country selector shows Tanzania 🇹🇿 and Kenya 🇰🇪 flags and names
Country selector switches between countries (header updates from TRA to KRA)
All three demo mode cards present: Citizen App Demo, Admin Dashboard, Side-by-Side View
Citizen App Demo loads with phone mockup showing TaxDraw app
Prize configuration modal opens and displays all three prize categories (Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly)
Prize configuration shows preset buttons (10M, 25M, 50M, 100M etc.) for all categories
Prize configuration shows current values in local currency format
Side-by-Side view displays both Citizen Mobile App and Tax Authority panels simultaneously
Side-by-Side view shows real-time connection between citizen and authority sides
Side-by-Side citizen panel shows mini phone interface with merchant options
Side-by-Side authority panel shows live stats (Scans Today, Compliance percentage)
Receipt scanning simulation workflow functions (scanning → verifying → result phases)
VAT calculations displayed in receipt verification details
Fullscreen button visible in header (expand icon in top-right corner)
Navigation between demo modes works correctly
Back to Menu navigation functions properly
Prize pool displays show currency amounts (TZS format)
All demo data properly mocked in frontend for presentation purposes
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix country switching bug: When user switches from Tanzania to Kenya, ensure all demo modes update to show Kenya-specific data (Kenya merchants like Carrefour Nairobi, Naivas Supermarket, Quickmart Kisumu and KES currency instead of Tanzania merchants and TZS currency). success_percentage: frontend: 90% - All major presentation demo features working with one medium-priority country switching bug
